body.prompt: Rewrite the sentence beginning with 'By the time': She was exhausted because she had been working on the project for twelve hours before the deadline arrived.
acceptable: By the time the deadline arrived, she had been working on the project for twelve hours and was exhausted.
By the time the deadline arrived, she had been working on the project for twelve hours; she was exhausted.

_provenance.cefr_reasoning: The item requires transforming a sentence using the past perfect continuous ('had been working') with 'By the time', a structure typically introduced at B2. The vocabulary is accessible, but the tense manipulation and duration-before-past-event logic demand B2-level grammatical control.

blind_solve_answer.answer: By the time the deadline arrived, she had been working on the project for twelve hours, so she was exhausted.

explanation.explanation_en: The past perfect continuous ('had been working') describes an activity that continued over a period of time up to a later past event. When rephrasing with 'By the time', the ongoing action must keep the past perfect continuous form, showing duration ('for twelve hours') leading up to the deadline.
explanation.explanation_vi: Thì quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn ('had been working') diễn tả một hành động kéo dài trong một khoảng thời gian cho đến một sự kiện khác trong quá khứ. Khi viết lại với 'By the time', hành động kéo dài phải giữ dạng quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn, thể hiện khoảng thời gian ('for twelve hours') trước khi hạn chót đến.

body.correct_answer: By the time the deadline arrived, she had been working on the project for twelve hours, so she was exhausted.

explanation.explanation_en: The past perfect continuous ('had been trying') describes an action that continued over a period of time before another past event (the fire brigade's arrival). 'Were trying' lacks the 'before another past action' meaning, and 'have been trying' is present tense, which cannot be used with a past reference point.
explanation.explanation_vi: Thì quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn ('had been trying') diễn tả một hành động kéo dài trong một khoảng thời gian trước một sự việc khác trong quá khứ (khi lính cứu hỏa đến). 'Were trying' thiếu ý nghĩa 'trước một hành động quá khứ khác', còn 'have been trying' là thì hiện tại, không dùng được với mốc thời gian trong quá khứ.

body.objective: Understand the formation and core uses of the Past Perfect Continuous (had been + V-ing), including how it expresses the duration of an activity that continued up to a point in the past, and use it accurately in narration and reporting.

explanation.en: The Past Perfect Continuous is formed with 'had been' + the present participle (V-ing): I had been working, she had been waiting. It is used to talk about an action or state that was in progress over a period of time before another past event or moment. It emphasizes the duration or continuous nature of the earlier activity, often answering 'how long?'. Typical time markers include 'for', 'since', 'all day', 'by the time'. It is frequently used to give background reasons or causes for a past situation (e.g., 'He was tired because he had been working all night'), and in reported speech to shift 'have/has been + V-ing' back one tense ('I have been waiting' → 'She said she had been waiting'). Unlike the Past Perfect Simple, which focuses on completed actions or results, the Past Perfect Continuous focuses on the ongoing process. State verbs (know, believe, own, love) are normally not used in continuous forms; use the Past Perfect Simple instead ('I had known her for years', not 'I had been knowing').
explanation.vi: Quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn được cấu thành bằng 'had been' + động từ thêm -ing: I had been working, she had been waiting. Thì này dùng để nói về một hành động diễn ra và kéo dài trong một khoảng thời gian trước một sự kiện hoặc thời điểm khác trong quá khứ. Nó nhấn mạnh tính kéo dài hoặc liên tục của hành động, thường trả lời câu hỏi 'bao lâu?'. Các dấu hiệu thời gian thường gặp: 'for', 'since', 'all day', 'by the time'. Thì này cũng thường dùng để nêu nguyên nhân hoặc bối cảnh cho một tình huống trong quá khứ (ví dụ: 'He was tired because he had been working all night' – Cậu ấy mệt vì đã làm việc cả đêm). Trong câu tường thuật, 'have/has been + V-ing' được lùi về 'had been + V-ing' ('I have been waiting' → 'She said she had been waiting'). Khác với Quá khứ hoàn thành đơn (nhấn mạnh hành động đã hoàn thành hoặc kết quả), Quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn nhấn mạnh quá trình đang diễn ra. Lưu ý: động từ trạng thái (know, believe, own, love) thường không dùng ở dạng tiếp diễn; hãy dùng Quá khứ hoàn thành đơn ('I had known her for years', không nói 'I had been knowing').

common_mistakes.why: State verbs such as 'know', 'believe', 'love', and 'own' describe states, not ongoing actions, so they are not used in continuous forms. Use the Past Perfect Simple instead.
common_mistakes.right: I had known him since childhood.
common_mistakes.wrong: I had been knowing him since childhood.

common_mistakes.why: When the reference point is in the past, use 'had been + V-ing', not 'has/have been + V-ing'.
common_mistakes.right: She was tired because she had been working all night.
common_mistakes.wrong: She was tired because she has been working all night.
